name: The Heart of the Mountain
label: Quest
description: The Heart of the Mountain: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For years I have sought a certain gem. It is called the Heart of the Mountain and it's the size of your fist! The Dark Iron dwarves have it locked in their vault and, try as I may, they won't let me purchase it.
So I must resort to force.

Fight your way to the Lower Vault of Blackrock Depths, breach its secret safe and gain the Heart. To do that, you must defeat Watchman Doomgrip, and he won't appear until you've opened every relic coffer in the vault!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the Heart of the Mountain? To me, its value is without limit.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have the heart! Amazing! It is even more beautiful than I imagined!
Please, friend, take this as payment!
